name: Doomsdate
source:
Congratulations, and happy doomsday! You've been selected as the harbinger of the apocalypse! No more of your strange, sucky, everyday life. 
Lucky for you, the four horsemen want you to decide who's going to lead the charge for the destruction of sinners. Even luckier for you, they're all kind of cute... and interested!

[from [url=https://succulantics.itch.io/doomsdate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜你，末日快乐！你被选为世界末日的预兆！不再有你奇怪的、糟糕的日常生活。
对你来说幸运的是，四骑士希望你决定谁将带头消灭罪人。对你来说更幸运的是，他们都很可爱……而且很感兴趣！

[来自[url=https://succulantics.itch.io/doomsdate]itch.io[/url]]
